description: The interview travel costs an unemployed job seeker in Finland may claim: kilometre compensation above the share the claimant pays, capped, plus overnight stays, with the claim deadline and a reminder date. Takes the kilometres, the trip date and optionally nights, municipality and the job's length and hours. Reimbursement is discretionary and municipalities can set their own rules; the result gives the rules version. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

distanceKm.description: Total kilometres claimed for the trip (both ways when the claim covers both).

jobWeeks.description: How many weeks the job lasts.

municipality.description: The claimant's municipality, for local caps.

tripDate.description: A date as YYYY-MM-DD (Finnish calendar date).

name: calculate_interview_travel_claim

basis.description: Where the figures come from: source, as-of date and sample.

dataUse.description: What may be reused from this result and how to credit JobCrawls.

limitReached.description: Present when a weekly limit stopped the call: which limit, its size and when it resets.

links.description: JobCrawls pages for the jobs and companies mentioned.

openInJobCrawls.description: A JobCrawls page with the full result.
